function.name: send_text_link_inbound
function.description: Sends an SMS text message with a program-specific link to the lead's phone (via GoHighLevel). Use it only after the lead agrees. For Miami Valley, linkKey is required: use 'neuropathy' for the Neuropathy $25 reservation-payment link and 'back_neck' only for the Back & Neck link. The backend rejects a missing or invalid Miami Valley linkKey. Never read the URL aloud, and never tell the caller a text was sent unless this tool returned success.

linkKey.description: Required for Miami Valley. Use 'neuropathy' for its Neuropathy payment link or 'back_neck' for its Back & Neck link.

contactId.description: ID del contacto en GHL si está disponible (opcional). Normalmente no es necesario: el backend lo resuelve desde la metadata de la llamada.

phone.description: Número de teléfono del lead (opcional). Solo úsalo si el contactId no está disponible; normalmente el backend lo resuelve desde la metadata de la llamada.
